qs.q: Which organism causes a sexually transmitted infection characterized by a painful genital ulcer known as chancroid?
qs.e: Haemophilus ducreyi causes chancroid, which is a painful genital ulcer. Treponema pallidum causes syphilis, featuring a typically painless primary chancre.
